newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dywidad eyes stable results in 97.
newsitem.headline: Dywidad eyes stable results in 97.

text.p: German construction group Dyckerhoff & Widmann (Dywidag) said on Thursday that it expected stable results in 1997 despite ongoing sluggish conditions in the building industry.
In 1996 the group posted a net profit at 40.5 million marks ($23.9 million) compared with 44.5 million marks posted in 1995.
In its annual report the group said it was looking for unchanged profits this year and a slightly higher output, adding the forecast was based on a good order situation in the early part of the year.
In the first quarter, the group said it had increased its output by around 12 percent. Orders were 9 percent higher at 836 million marks.
